episodeTitle.en: Everyone’s an engineer now: Inside v0’s mission to create 100 million builders | Guillermo Rauch
episodeTitle.zh: 如今人人都是工程师：v0如何致力于培养1亿名创客 | 吉列尔莫·劳奇

guestBioOfficial.en: Guillermo Rauch is the founder and CEO of Vercel, creators of v0 (one of the most popular AI app building tools), and the mind behind foundational JavaScript frameworks like Next.js and Socket.io. An open source pioneer and legendary engineer, Guillermo has built tools that power some of the internet’s most innovative products, including Midjourney, Grok, and Notion. His mission is to democratize product creation, expanding the pool of potential builders from 5 million developers to over 100 million people worldwide. In this episode, you’ll learn: 1. How AI will radically speed up product development—and the three critical skills PMs and engineers should master now to stay ahead
guestBioOfficial.zh: 吉列尔莫·劳奇（Guillermo Rauch）是Vercel的创始人兼首席执行官，Vercel是v0（最受欢迎的人工智能应用构建工具之一）的开发者，也是Next.js和Socket.io等基础JavaScript框架背后的核心人物。作为开源领域的先驱和传奇工程师，吉列尔莫开发的工具为包括Midjourney、Grok和Notion在内的互联网最具创新性的产品提供了支持。他的使命是推动产品创作民主化，将潜在开发者的数量从500万增加到全球超过1亿。在本期节目中，您将了解：1. 人工智能将如何极大地加速产品开发进程——以及产品经理和工程师现在应掌握的三项关键技能，以保持领先地位

title.en: Everyone’s an engineer now: Inside v0’s mission to create 100 million builders | Guillermo Rauch
title.zh: 如今人人都是工程师：v0如何致力于培养1亿名创客 | 吉列尔莫·劳奇

summary.en: Guillermo explains how AI is dissolving the line between roles—designers who can ship full products, PMs who can prototype to production—and why understanding how things work 'under the hood' still matters for steering models. He reframes taste as a developable skill built through 'exposure hours' trying lots of products, and predicts a future where 'AI becomes synonymous with software.' The episode is essential listening for understanding which skills to focus on as product development is reshaped by AI.
summary.zh: Guillermo 解释了 AI 如何消融角色边界——设计师能交付完整产品、PM 能做出可上线的原型——以及为何理解“底层原理”对驾驭模型依然重要。他把“品味”重新定义为一种可通过“沉浸时长”（大量试用各种产品）来培养的能力，并预言未来“AI 将成为软件的代名词”。这期节目对于理解在 AI 重塑产品开发之际该聚焦哪些技能，是不可错过的必听内容。
